title: Current role at AWS Connect
content: Anqi is currently a Software Development Engineer at Amazon Web Services on the AWS Connect team in Seattle, Washington. She has been in this role since September 2022.

title: Distributed systems scope
content: Her engineering work includes building large-scale event-driven distributed systems that support more than 500 million daily chat interactions.

title: LLM and incident automation
content: She designed LLM-powered automation for incident response and reduced triage time by 80 percent across production microservices.

title: Reliability and infrastructure
content: She improved reliability and scalability through asynchronous architectures, observability, and cloud-native infrastructure on AWS and Kubernetes.

title: Technical product management
content: Before AWS, Anqi worked as a Technical Product Manager at Amifor Management in Atlanta from May 2021 to August 2022, leading cross-functional product and engineering work.

title: Smart lock application
content: At Amifor Management, she worked on a smart lock app with more than 1,000 daily active users and improved workflow efficiency by 60 percent through automation and KPI dashboards.

title: Information Systems degree
content: Anqi is completing a Master of Science in Information Systems at Trine University, with dates listed as January 2023 through December 2025.

title: Business Analytics degree
content: She also earned a Master of Science in Business Analytics from Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, with dates listed as August 2019 through December 2020.

title: Overall profile
content: Her overall profile combines backend engineering, distributed systems, AI automation, and product-minded execution. She is a strong fit for backend, platform, infrastructure, and applied AI engineering roles.
